# cork-quick-links

A quick links menu component: a short list of links/buttons outside of the main navigation.
Add it as a child of the cork-header element.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headerComponentLabel` | `String` | Label for the menu, e.g. in the header's nav tray. Default: 'Quick Links'. Attribute: header-component-label. |
| `highlight` | `Boolean` | Shows the first three links as large highlighted buttons. Attribute: highlight. |
| `twoColumns` | `Boolean` | Shows the links in two columns, when there's room. Attribute: two-columns. |
| `homeSite` | `Boolean` | Adds the ucdavis home site's icons to the first three links. Attribute: home-site. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Links: a/button elements, or a ul/ol of li elements. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM. |

## Methods

### static get shadowRootOptions

Lit shadow root options. delegatesFocus forwards focus() on the element to its first focusable control,
e.g. when cork-header opens its nav tray.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-quick-links';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkQuickLinks from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-quick-links/cork-quick-links.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-quick-links highlight two-columns>
  <a href="/hours">Hours</a>
  <a href="/give">Give</a>
  <a href="/contact">Contact</a>
  <button>Chat with a librarian</button>
</cork-quick-links>
```
